review_method: Read-only production adapter/core/hook/schema, original sender and ownership sources, independent AST-literal five-file reconstruction/reversal, retained ELF/raw stream/hash inspection. No supplier imports, tests, compiler/dependency query, original Map/serializer/session or accepted qualifier replay.
source_findings: Only four original Map translation units plus accepted fresh GROUPS profile are changed in private staging. Whole LF-normalized baselines and every literal once-only insertion independently reconstruct five exact patched hashes in D integration proof and reverse to actual accepted archive/original source bytes. Four overlay bytes match current supplier. No upstream source is edited.

Ledger arms only after original successful same-owner GROUPS finish/commit. Borrowed link is captured before accepted finish clears its boundary; fresh registered link membership/backlinks, actual entity table/state, initialized character and immutable private identity values are revalidated before owner-event use. Existing same-source/native GROUPS logical pairing remains separately required by runtime.

Every exported hook captures and restores errno/GetLastError and checks immutable accepted GROUPS owner thread before mutable ledger/private-key access. Unrelated owner events do not advance the ledger; changed registered owner refuses and retires. Nullable character hooks avoid new client dereference. entFreeDbg retires matching keys before unlink/free; first terminal result/refusal latches. Serialized exclusive Map owner thread remains a precondition.

Original dispatch/state writes, backlog and map-transfer calls, viewed-entity selection, packet serializer/character calls and final pktSend each retain their original invocation/control order. Initial full update is selected by original ready/sent_self predicates; observer does not add READY/ACK prerequisites. Private packet address becomes uintptr_t before call, pending return must match exact token, and no packet pointer is read or dereferenced after potentially consuming pktSend.

pkt_send_called is the persisted pre-call hook checkpoint: alone it proves about-to-call instrumentation was reached. pkt_send_returned with FINAL_RETURN proves the synchronous original call returned. Raw0/1 is preserved; fragmentation can return0 after child enqueue, so neither flag/result establishes queue acceptance, socket send, delivery or complete character acceptance.

Core allocates no memory and performs no original-object reads/callbacks/I/O. Source adapter retains bounded global state and one held file handle, uses fixed4096B JSON stack buffer, milestone/state/power-of-two tick writes and128 ordinary-write limit. Diagnostic exhaustion retires only observer. No whole-server stack/RSS/GPU fit claim follows.

Sink opens only caller-precreated single-link regular no-reparse file with exclusive share and retained volume/index identity. Writes flush and recheck same handle; I/O failure best-effort invalidates same file then closes. ACTIVE is last successfully persisted checkpoint and cannot establish later absence, exact final counts or continued sink health. Host providers explicitly double Win32/Map state; actual kernel/serializer/full target build and transaction are separate qualifications.

Fixed46-key schema includes booleans, bounded counts/enums/bit lengths/flags only. Private link/client/entity/character keys, packet token, account, DBID/auth IDs, endpoints and file identity are not serialized. Queue/socket/source-generation/complete-character/actor/applicationACK/world flags alwaysfalse. No protocol, timeout, budget, serializer predicate or ACK behavior changed.
